documents.title: Helicobacter pylori: Fact Sheet for Health Care Providers ...
documents.snippet: Jul 1, 1998 · Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori) is a spiral-shaped bacterium that is found in the gastric mucous layer or adherent to the epithelial lining of the stomach. H. pylori causes more than 90% of duodenal ulcers and up to 80% of gastric ulcers.

documents.title: Helicobacter pylori - CDC Stacks
documents.snippet: \(H.\ pylori\) metabolizes the urea rapidly, and the labeled carbon is absorbed. This labeled carbon can then be measured as \( \text{CO}_2 \) in the patient’s expired breath to determine whether \(H.\ pylori\) is present. The sensitivity and specificity of the breath test ranges from 94% to 98%.
